def: to braid (i.e. to entangle or snare) or catch (game) in anet

occurrences.text: The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting: but the substance of a diligent man is precious.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
